scope: 15 DEV frames x five variants; all30 transformed/annotated native road/glare sheets viewed; six full native raw frames additionally viewed
crop_spatial_mapping: sheet_xy translated to original native xy; no scaling/crop change between variants

shortlist_proposal.reason: Gamma visibly lifts shadow/midtone road and truck underbody in DEV samples (0/14/7072/7132/7311), with less highlight expansion than the tested exposure gain. This provides a specific visibility hypothesis worth testing on continuous tracks; it does not win on sparse detection counts.
material_regressions_and_unknowns: Frame14 visible motor loses motorcycle bbox compared with raw.
Frame2277 added car bbox overlaps visible near-motor front; category/component identity unresolved.
Frame2337 small background motorcycle bbox absent; physical identity of tiny bbox unresolved.
Frame7072 duplicate overlapping truck bboxes persist.
Frame7252 tiny two-wheeler bicycle/motorcycle disagreement remains unresolved.
Blur and burned-in metadata occlusion remain; gamma makes dark texture/noise more visible.

others_deferred.reason: Stronger observed highlight expansion; raw car at7311 no longer emitted; no temporal benefit established.
Visible shadow detail is crushed in multiple road samples; vehicle motorcycle bbox absent at14/29; single truck bbox at7072 is not proof of downstream benefit.
Does not brighten shadow materially or remove motion blur; extra car2277 and class disagreement2397 remain; temporal benefit unknown.

required_next_evidence: Continuous raw vs gamma DEV replay with identical detector/tracker/ReID/counting controls and native geometry.
Compare same physical passages, measured vehicle BC crossing source, duplicates/merges, categories, missing support and regressions.
Freeze candidate before any hold-out enhancement/inference; no gamma production acceptance from this screening.

per_frame_reviews.photometric_observation: Jalan bagian depan relatif kosong pada crop; lampu jauh dan area rumah kanan tetap terang. Gamma memperlihatkan tekstur aspal dan tepi gelap lebih jelas, sedangkan contrast menghitamkan shadow.
per_frame_reviews.detection_observation: Kelima varian hanya mengeluarkan person di area rumah kanan. Identitas fisik objek kecil tersebut belum dipastikan. Tidak ada dasar untuk menyimpulkan seluruh frame tidak mengandung kendaraan.
